corrections.issue: Final QA artifacts delivered to Visual Inspector do not preserve the viewport dimensions OpenCode reported.
corrections.evidence: Delivered files observed in QA were 963×2048 desktop, 405×2048 tablet, and 159×2048 mobile, despite the report claiming 1440×3061, 768×3879, and 390×4993.
corrections.target: The exact final PNGs at the state/render paths must retain the intended 1440, 768, and 390 pixel widths with full-page height and no downstream resampling.
corrections.implementation_guidance: Trace capture -> write -> copy/export -> final repository path. Verify dimensions on the exact final files after the last operation. Do not compensate with CSS.
corrections.verification: Read PNG metadata from the exact final v3 files and report it. Desktop=1440px wide, tablet=768px, mobile=390px.

corrections.issue: Results region collapses into a narrow content cluster instead of the approved persistent sidebar + wide three-column results area.
corrections.target: Within the Calder container, render a persistent desktop filter rail at left and a minmax(0,1fr) results column at right containing toolbar, exactly three product columns, pagination, and results-aligned help CTA.
corrections.implementation_guidance: Inspect the rendered DOM and computed styles from collection section through product list/card parents. Find the width-constraining Lumia/Bootstrap classes or flex/grid rules. Fix the parent layout contract rather than stacking more card-level overrides.
corrections.verification: At 1440px the results region uses the available container width, filter rail is visible, and three equal card columns occupy the right side without large unused whitespace.

corrections.issue: B1 cards are compressed into tiny columns; images are absent and text/prices/CTAs wrap or truncate.
corrections.target: Render the accepted calder-product-card at its intended listing width in three desktop columns, with visible product image, approved hierarchy, fitment badge/status, finish/sizes/price and full-width dark CTA.
corrections.implementation_guidance: Do not redesign calder-product-card. Inspect its actual DOM, stylesheet loading, parent display/flex-basis/min-width/max-width rules, and any Lumia selectors still targeting product items. Remove integration conflicts at the collection wrapper/item level.
corrections.verification: Three B1 cards fit the results column with normal internal proportions and no clipped/stacked micro-layout.

corrections.issue: Complete dark Calder footer is still not visible and a large white trailing region remains.

Remove the spacer from Collection if it is not part of the approved page. Inspect footer computed display/background/height and any template conditions. Do not redesign footer.liquid.
